provenance_note: Mined from the MIT-licensed sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine repository's own client-data extraction (data/spells.jsonl), which that project's NOTICE.md credits as derived from the WoW Forever beta client. Spot-checked against foreverdb.net (an independently-run WoW Forever client-data site, robots.txt-cleared for AI fetch) for shadow_bolt and immolate; both matched exactly. This pack shares no code or files with wowsimforever's own data-packs/ - it is an independent extraction for this separate project. Rev2 adds three pet/talent-mechanic entries (firebolt, lash_of_pain, demonic_brand_hit) mined from the same engine repository's prepare/export.rs, which carries them as literal Go-ported constants rather than auto-generated rows - see each entry's own source field.
known_conflicts: The sibling wowsimforever project's docs/PLAN.md and data-packs/ (an unrelated, separate project in this same repo) recorded Shadow Bolt's max-rank average as 251 as of 2026-10-17/18, sourced from thewowdb.com at client build 1.60.1.70450. This pack's value (268, from build 1.60.1.70425, confirmed by two independent sources as of 2026-10-23) is HIGHER, not a rounding difference. Build 70450 postdates 70425, so this is most likely a genuine beta balance pass between those two builds, not a sourcing error on either side. Not resolved further since this pack does not depend on or reference that project's data.

firebolt's Go-literal source cites client build 1.60.1.70094, earlier than this pack's main spells mined from 1.60.1.70425 - the auto-generated table used for everything else has no pet-spell rows at all, so this is the best available source, not a build mismatch introduced by this pack's own mining.

shadow_bolt.source: sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine (MIT license), data/spells.jsonl, client build 1.60.1.70425, spell id 25307. Cross-checked against foreverdb.net/spell/25307 on 2026-10-23: site shows "253 to 283 Shadow damage" (avg 268) and SPCoef 0.857 - exact match to mined base_points=268, sp_coefficient=0.857.

immolate.source: sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine (MIT license), data/spells.jsonl, client build 1.60.1.70425, spell id 25309. Note: foreverdb.net labels this 'Rank 8' (its own rank count scheme for the 8 total Immolate ranks); this pack's ladder also has it as the 8th and final entry, so the numbering is consistent, not a conflict.

direct._scaling_note: base_points scales with character level via ppl=0.6/level above spell_level=58, capped at max_level=63; at CHARACTER_LEVEL=60 this averages to floor(44.0 + 2*0.6) = 45.0 before spell power. This engine's Rust code applies that pre-computed average (45.0) directly rather than re-deriving the level-scaling formula.

firebolt.source: sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine (MIT license), src/classes/warlock/prepare/export.rs imp_firebolt_effect() and src/prepare/character.rs CHARACTER_LEVEL=60 - a Go-ported literal the engine's own comment cites as 'client-verified beta 1.60.1.70094 11763' (an earlier build than this pack's main 1.60.1.70425, since the auto-generated spell table the rest of this pack was mined from has no pet-spell rows at all). Not independently cross-checked against a second site - foreverdb.net 404s for spell id 11763 (checked 2026-10-23). This replaces an earlier, genuinely-unsourced placeholder (100.0) that shipped in rev1's first implementation pass.
